method: Manual browser interaction via CUA on production build
checks: Database reference shows 21 business tables, 8 application logical tables/indexes, 157 fields, 14 metrics
Employee table displays all 11 fields, types, keys and links; metric tab exposes actual attendance_rate SQL expression
Debugger starts real LM Studio query and displays running model node with input before output arrives
Successful run has 15 actual nodes; SQL output shows 5 direct and 453 indirect reports
Chat unsupported age query links to its failed capability node, input, error and matched condition
History selection works; trace persists across production restart
Previous-query checkbox can be selected for successful history and cancelled after a failed run
1360px desktop and 390px narrow viewport checked; narrow page content width equals client width
No browser console errors after loading current production build; viewport override reset
limitations: This is a manual UI regression record, not an automated browser E2E suite.
Existing 20-case model regression is scenario coverage, not unrestricted accuracy.
